• Respects silent mode and Do Not Disturb
• Spanish and English
No accounts. No cloud. No ads. No tracking. All your data stays on your phone.
The name is a Spanish pun: pomodoro is Italian for tomato, which is where the technique's name comes from. And yes, it also nods to an old tinned-tomato commercial.

- Password Strength Scoring: Visual feedback on password security.
- Backups: Import or Export encrypted/unencrypted data

- Custom Backup Location: Choose where to save your backups using Storage Access Framework.
- Third-Party Import: Seamlessly import existing vault from Bitwarden and KeePass.

- Filter/Search Entries

fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.summary: Offline audio player for QR-linked music. Ideal for music trivia board games.
fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.description:
QR Jukebox is a lightweight, generic offline audio player designed to bridge the gap between physical objects and digital music. By mapping QR codes to your local music library, it becomes the perfect companion for DIY board games.
 Perfect for Music Trivia Games: This app was designed with versatility in mind. It is highly compatible with popular modern music trivia games (such as Hitster™). If you own a local collection of the songs from your favorite game, you can use QR Jukebox as a fast, privacy-friendly, and 100% offline alternative to the official online player. It even supports original URL structures to make mapping your library a breeze.
 How it works: The app scans a QR code containing a URL and maps it to a specific local audio file by mirroring the URL's path structure in your local filesystem.
 The domain of the URL is the root folder.
 All path segments before the last one are treated as subdirectories.
 The last segment is the track ID (filename prefix).
 Key Features: 
 Offline First: No internet connection required once your media is on the device.
 Privacy Focused: No tracking, no ads, and no cloud sync.
 Metadata and Art: Can display title, artist, album, and fullscreen cover art from ID3 tags.
 Customizable Playback: Set a global start offset (e.g. 30s) to skip intros automatically.
 Game Timer: Optional stopwatch to track "thinking time" per card or scan.
 Easy Navigation: Quick 10s skip buttons and smooth marquee for long titles.
 Supported Formats: .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .flac
 Disclaimer: This app is a generic tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Hitster™ or any other board game manufacturer. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.description:
Termux Hub is a lightweight, open-source Android application that indexes and organizes tools designed for use with Termux .
 It provides a clean, searchable catalog of community tools using a transparent, metadata-driven data pipeline.
 The app focuses on reproducibility and reliability. All tool information is processed automatically from a public GitHub repository,
 validated, and stored locally on your device. Once synced, the local database becomes the single source of truth,
 ensuring fast access even when offline.
 Key features
 Browse and search curated Termux tools by category
 View detailed tool information, installation commands, and repositories
 Daily updates of GitHub star counts and README content (00:00 UTC)
 Offline-first design with local Room database storage
 No trackers, no analytics, no ads
 How it works
 Termux Hub fetches static metadata from GitHub and processes tool data, star counts,
 and README files independently. All validated data is stored in a local Room database.
 If syncing fails, the app safely falls back to cached or bundled data.
 Data sources
 All data is read-only and sourced from the public
 TermuxHub GitHub repository .
 This includes tool metadata, repositories, thumbnails, GitHub stars, READMEs,
 and Hall of Fame entries.
 Privacy
 Termux Hub does not collect personal data, does not require accounts,
 and does not include tracking, analytics, or advertising libraries.
 Contributing
 Anyone can help improve the catalog. To add or update a tool,
 please see the contribution guidelines in
 CONTRIBUTING.md .

fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.name: Tetherbug
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.summary: Your Mac turns on your phone's hotspot when its Wi-Fi disconnects. No taps.
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.description:
When your Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects, Tetherbug turns on your Android phone's hotspot and your Mac joins it, the way Instant Hotspot works with an iPhone. No reaching for your phone, no tapping through settings.
How it works
• Your Mac and phone stay paired over Bluetooth. When the Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects and no known network is around, it asks the phone for its hotspot.
• Tetherbug turns the hotspot on through Shizuku, and your Mac joins it.
• The hotspot shows up in your Mac's Wi-Fi menu as a Personal Hotspot, with the link icon, just like an iPhone's.
• Once nothing has used the hotspot for a while, Android turns it off again. You choose how long.
What you need
• Android 13 or later
• Shizuku, which lets Tetherbug switch the hotspot without root
• A Mac with macOS 14 or later, running the free Tetherbug app for Mac: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug
Private by design
• Tetherbug has no internet access and collects no data.
• Only a Mac you've paired with your phone can see its status or turn its hotspot on, and the Bluetooth link between them is encrypted.
Open source under the MIT license: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug

fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.name: Open TimeLimit
fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.description:
This App (Open TimeLimit) is mostly equal to TimeLimit without the linking of multiple devices.
Flexible
Apps are grouped to categories (a category can contain one or multiple App).
You can chose per category at which times it should be allowed. This allows preventing playing games too late.
Additionally, you can configure time limit rules. These rules limit the total usage duration at one day or over multiple days (e.g. a weekend). It is possible to combine both, e.g. 2 hours per week end day, but in total only 3 hours.
Moreover, there is the possibility to set an extra time. This allows using something longer than regulary once. This can be used as bonus. There is additionally the option to disable all time limits temporarily (e.g. for the whole day or an hour).
Multi user support
There is the scenario that one device is used by exactly one user. However, with tablets, there are often multiple possible users. Due to that, it is possible to create multiple user profiles in TimeLimit. Each user has got different settings and time counters. There are two kinds of users: parents and children. If a parent was chosen as user, then there are no restrictions. Parents can chose any other user as current user.
Notes
It can be a good idea to take a look at https://timelimit.io/en/configsuggestions/ if you don't use TimeLimit in the default scenario.
TimeLimit does not work good at some smartphone brands (mostly Huawei and Wiko). With the correct settings, it can work better. But better is not good.
If it "does not work": This can be caused by power saving features. You can find at https://dontkillmyapp.com/ how you can disable these features. Get in touch with the support if that does not help.
Depending on the Android version, TimeLimit uses the permission for the usage stats access or the GET_TASKS permission. These are only used to detect the currently used App. Based on the currently used App, the App is blocked, allowed, or the remaining time is calculated.

TimeLimit uses the notification access to block notifications of blocked apps and to count and block background playback. Notifications and their contents are not saved.
TimeLimit uses an accessibility service to press the home button before showing the lock screen. This fixes blocking in some cases. Moreover, this allows opening the lockscreen at newer Android versions.
TimeLimit uses the permission "draw over other Apps" to allow opening the lockscreen at newer android versions and to overlay blocked Apps until the lockscreen is launched.
TimeLimit uses the location access to detect the used WiFi network and allow/ block Apps depending on it and your settings. The location access is not used otherwise.

fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.description:
Smart migraine tracking that stays on your device.
Megrim is an open-source, offline-first migraine diary that helps you find your personal triggers. The app automatically adds time-of-day, season, daylight, and moon context to your entries — and, if you opt in, local weather and barometric pressure — calculating correlations entirely on your phone. With no accounts, no cloud servers, and zero tracking, your health data stays completely private and under your control.
What's inside:
* Automatic on-device enrichment — daylight hours, time of day, season, and moon phase computed locally; opt in to add local weather and barometric-pressure change (24h/48h). No manual entry.
* Real personal analytics — migraine days per month (the last 30 days, a 3-month average and a monthly chart), trends by day-of-week, time-of-day, season, daylight, pressure change, and moon phase, plus a "suspected factors" card that uses odds ratios over your own log.
* Clear days count too — tap "No migraine today" to record a good day, and Megrim compares your sleep, stress, triggers and foods on migraine days against clear days.
* Fast logging — one tap starts a migraine, or long-press the app icon and choose "Log migraine". Record symptoms, how much it affected your day, attacks without headache, medications and non-drug relief.
* Medications — classes for acute medications with a monthly medication-days count and a medication-overuse notice, preventives with start and stop dates, and what helped.
* Optional reminders — a daily reminder to log, and a "Migraine in progress" notification with an End button. Off until you turn them on (the notification permission is asked for only then), and never shown on a secure lock screen.
* Your data stays yours — on-device storage only, with full export and import (JSON and CSV), a printable PDF report for your doctor, and an optional backup reminder.
* Optional app lock — open Megrim with your phone's own fingerprint, face or PIN, and hide it in the recent-apps switcher.
* No accounts, no servers, no telemetry — by default the app makes no automatic network requests (the only exception is the place-name search you type when setting your home location). Weather enrichment is opt-in; when enabled, the only network request is to Open-Meteo.com, to fetch weather for the approximate (~1 km rounded) location and date of the entries you create.
* Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).
Megrim is a personal diary and is NOT a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. "Suspected factors" are statistical associations in your own log — association is not causation. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.

130 AWARDS TO UNLOCK

READ TOGETHER IN PRIVATE BOOK CLUBS

flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.description:
A powerful, scriptable, modular calculator aimed at scientific, engineering or computing work. Long calculations can be written as a list of calculations, storing results into variables to be used in the next stage. All features can be added, removed, and customised, and new features can be written in python.
 Features:
 Numbers can be in any base and convert to another base
 Variable assignment
 Statistical and trigonometry functions
 Date and time manipulations and calculations
 Boolean logic
 Units, including conversion to other units - metric, US customary and British Imperial units supported
 Arrays - any operator or function can accept arrays as input and automatically execute across the entire array
 String manipulation, including regular expressions - strings can be used as numbers, and vice-versa

flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.name: KCachegrind
flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.description:
KCachegrind is a profile data visualization tool, used to determine the most time consuming
 parts in the execution of a program.
 Features:
 KCachegrind visualizes profiles (i.e. runtime characteristics) of applications in various
 ways, including call graph visualisations and source/disassembler annotation.
 It can load profiles generated by the cache simulation/call tracer Calltree, a Valgrind tool.
 Thus, profiling does not need any preparation, can cope with shared libraries and plugin architectures,
 and does not influence the measuring itself.
 Converter scripts for OProfile, Perl, and PHP.
 Switching between multiple visualization layouts.
 Call graph can be exported as image (PNG).
 Simultaneous display of 2 event types in Call and Annotation View

flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.description:
KMyMoney is a personal finance manager by KDE. It comes with a large set of features while being
 easy to use for the non-technical user.
 It supports different account types, categorisation of expenses and incomes, reconciliation
 of bank accounts and import/export to the “QIF” file format. Direct download using the OFX and
 HBCI formats is also possible via plugins. Online banking support (statement download) is also
 provided for the OFX and HBCI protocols.

flathub:org.kde.skrooge.description:
Skrooge is a personal finance manager powered by KDE that aims to be simple and intuitive. Skrooge allows you to keep track of your expenses and income, categorize them, and build reports of them.

 QIF, CSV, SKROOGE, KMYMONEY import/export
 Microsoft Money, OFX, QFX, MT940, GNUCASH, GRISBI, HOMEBANK and MONEY MANAGER EX import
 Advanced Graphical Reports
 Multiple tabs to help you organize your work
 Infinite undo/redo (even after the file was closed !)
 Instant filtering on transactions and reports
 Infinite category levels
 Mass update of transactions
 Scheduled transactions
 Track refund of your expenses
 Automatically process transactions based on search conditions
 Multiple currencies
 Budget
 Dashboard
 Advice

flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.name: mpz Music Player
flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.description:
A folder player for big local music collections. Instead of indexing every file into a library,
 mpz treats your files and folders as the library and provides a convenient way to build playlists
 directly from folders.
 The main feature is the three-column UI: a directory tree, the list of playlists, and the tracks
 of the current playlist — similar to Foobar2000's Album List. Choose library folders, middle-click
 a folder, and a playlist is created from it.
 Also supported: gapless playback, a 10-band and parametric equalizer with AutoEq presets, ReplayGain
 volume normalization, internet radio, CUE sheets, a tag editor, cover art and lyrics, MPRIS media
 control, and an experimental MPD client mode.

firefox-addons:2993471.summary: Protects against phishing, IP loggers, fake downloads & browser scams
firefox-addons:2993471.description:
🛡️ LinkSentry — Your Invisible Bodyguard While Browsing
LinkSentry automatically protects you from phishing, IP trackers, fake downloads, browser lockers, and fake shops — before you even notice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHY LINKSENTRY?
Every day, millions of people fall victim to online scams. Scammers are getting more sophisticated — fake websites look identical to real ones, IP loggers hide in harmless-looking links, and fake downloads disguise themselves as popular software.
LinkSentry detects these threats and blocks them at the network level — before your data is ever sent.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FREE FEATURES
🔒 Phishing Protection
Automatically blocks 157,000+ known scam sites from 4 daily-updated feeds. Sites are blocked at network level — they never even load.
📍 IP Logger Detection (UNIQUE!)
Detects 70+ known IP tracking services like Grabify, IPLogger, and more. When someone sends you a tracking link, LinkSentry blocks it before your IP address, location, or device data is ever transmitted.
⌨️ Typosquatting Warnings
Detects when you land on a fake domain that looks similar to a known website (e.g., paypa1.com instead of paypal.com ).
💾 Download Protection
Pauses suspicious downloads (.exe, .msi, .dmg) from unknown or very new domains and warns you before you open them.
🔒 Browser Locker Protection
Prevents websites from freezing your browser with fake virus warnings designed to trick you into calling a scam hotline.
⚙️ Protocol Blocker
Blocks 45 dangerous protocols (ms-settings, steam, discord, etc.) that try to launch programs on your computer.
🔗 Tab Protection
Automatically prevents websites from manipulating your other open tabs (reverse tabnabbing).
🔔 Notification Blocker
Blocks fake captcha tricks that cause browser notification spam on your desktop.
📋 Clipboard Protection
Blocks automatic clipboard access that wasn't initiated by you.
🏪 Fake Shop Detection
Analyzes online shops for suspicious signals: new domain, missing legal pages, crypto-only payments, extreme discounts.
🔒 Form Protection
Warns you when you enter passwords or credit card data on suspicious sites.
🌐 WebRTC Protection
Prevents suspicious sites from reading your real IP address via WebRTC — even if you're using a VPN.
🖱️ Right-Click Scanning
Right-click any link, then "Check with LinkSentry" — instantly see if it's safe without opening it.
📊 Dashboard
Clean dashboard shows you how many threats have been blocked.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRO FEATURES
⭐ Unlimited link scans
⭐ QR Code Scanner — check QR codes before scanning them with your phone
⭐ Email link protection — flags suspicious links in Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo
⭐ Messenger protection — flags links in WhatsApp Web and Telegram
⭐ OAuth consent scanner — warns about dangerous app permissions
⭐ Detailed reports — server country, redirect chain, certificate details
⭐ Evidence export — save evidence reports for law enforcement
⭐ Weekly protection report
⭐ Auto-cleanup — deletes cookies/trackers from suspicious sites
⭐ Fingerprint protection — prevents browser fingerprinting
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRIVACY & TECHNOLOGY
✅ 100% local — no server, no database, no cloud
✅ Zero data collection — LinkSentry collects no personal data
✅ Open architecture — blocklists from Phishing Army, OpenPhish, URLhaus
✅ Manifest V3 — latest Chrome extension standard
✅ Network-level blocking — declarativeNetRequest blocks threats before a single byte is sent
✅ Auto-updates every 6 hours
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GET STARTED FOR FREE
Full basic protection is and always will be free. Pro adds detailed reports, email protection, and unlimited scans — starting at $1.99/month. 7-day free trial included.

firefox-addons:2792249.name: File System Access
firefox-addons:2792249.summary: The File System Access API allows web apps to interact with files on the local device.
firefox-addons:2792249.description:
This extension brings the File System Access API to Firefox that helps web apps such as https://vscode.dev read and write local files and folders.
Main features:
* Implemented showOpenFilePicker, showDirectoryPicker, showSaveFilePicker functions and related interfaces.
* Set to enable specific File System Access features on matching web pages.
* Provides File System Access API for other compatible WebExtensions.
Notes:
* The local file operations required by this extension cannot be performed in the browser, and a helper app needs to be installed to assist in the related work. 
* The optional Code Editor feature is provided by the Code Editor extension.
Limitations:
* By default, FileSystemHandle will lose its instance methods after cloning (e.g. using IndexedDB or postMessage ), and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.CLONE_ENABLED . Web developers can use __FILE_SYSTEM_TOOLS__.parseHandle(handle) to restore the instance methods.
* Limited Worker context support and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.WORKER_ENABLED .
* Read file size is limited by the FS_CONFIG.FILE_SIZE_LIMIT . Web developers can read large file streams and slices with handle.getFile({ _allowNonNative: true }) , and write large file in-place with handle.createWritable({ _inPlace: true, keepExistingData: true }) .
* DataTransferItem.prototype.getAsFileSystemHandle is not implemented.
This extension is open source and you can file bug reports or feature requests on the GitHub issue . 
References:
* https://wicg.github.io/file-system-access/

apple-macos:1237892621.name: MySudo - Identity Protection
apple-macos:1237892621.description:
MySudo is the original all-in-one privacy app that lets you protect your information, secure your chat, and organize your life.
PROTECT YOUR INFORMATION with secure digital identities called Sudos, each with its own phone, email, handle, private browser, and virtual card. Anywhere you’d normally use your personal phone number, email or credit card, use your Sudo ones instead. Sign up for deals and discounts, book rental cars and hotel rooms, pay for concerts or a coffee—all without giving away your personal information. 
SECURE YOUR CHAT with end-to-end encrypted calls, texts and emails between MySudo users via your Sudo handle—or communicate standard outside the app with everyone else. Your Sudo phone and email work just like your personal ones AND they protect you from spam and scams. 
ORGANIZE YOUR LIFE with multiple Sudo digital identities, each with a different purpose. Depending on your plan, you can have up to 9 Sudos, so you can shop with a Sudo, date with a Sudo, order food with a Sudo, sell secondhand stuff with a Sudo, live with a Sudo. What happens in a Sudo stays in the Sudo, so your information is safe and organized. 
WHAT’S IN A SUDO?
 1 email address – for end-to-end encrypted emails between app users, and standard email with everyone else
 1 handle – for end-to-end encrypted messages and video, voice and group calls between app users
 1 private browser – for searching the internet without ads and tracking
 1 phone number (optional)* – for end-to-end encrypted messaging and video, voice and group calls between app users, and standard connections with everyone else; customizable and mutable
 1 virtual card (optional)* – for protecting your personal info and your money, like a proxy for your credit or debit card or bank account
*Phone numbers and virtual cards only available on a paid plan. Phone numbers available for US, CA and UK only. Virtual cards for US only.
SELECT THE PAID PLAN THAT’S RIGHT FOR YOU
SudoGo – the budget plan with a phone number
 1 phone number
 3 Sudos
 100 messages a month
 30 mins talk time a month
 3 GB space
SudoPro – the great value plan with more of everything
 3 phone numbers
 3 Sudos
 300 messages a month
 200 mins talk time a month
 5 GB space
SudoMax – the most Sudos for the most options
 9 phone numbers
 9 Sudos
 Unlimited messages
